House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; modifying grant caps for port development assistance; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 457A.03, subdivision 3.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 457A.03, subdivision 3, is amended to read:

Subd. 3.
State participation; limitations.
The commissioner may not provide any assistance under this chapter for more than 80 percent of the [-nonfederal share-][+ total cost+] of any project. Assistance provided under this chapter may not be used to match any other state funds. The commissioner shall not assume continuing funding responsibility for any commercial navigation facility project.
